prediction_text: Direction: No — Britain does not vote to leave the European Union in the referendum of 23 June 2016; the vote goes to Remain, narrowly. The Uranus–Ceres conjunction at 23 degrees Aries on referendum day signals upheaval and a shock to the expected order, but read against the UK national charts it marks the convulsion of the campaign and a near-miss rupture rather than an actual severance: the union with Europe survives this vote, with the membership question left unsettled and certain to return. Timing coordinate: the referendum date, 23 June 2016, given on the card.
basis: No tradition/system field is printed on this card; the item is a mundane-astrology referendum judgment (charts of 1066, 1801 and 1922, plus the referendum-day configuration) and is decided on that route. Card facts: assessment first published 5 July 2015 and firmed up 22 February 2016, just as the date was announced; February polls show 'Stay' ahead with many undecided; on referendum day Uranus and Ceres conjunct at 23 degrees Aries. Ceres (nurture, sustenance, the terms of belonging) struck by Uranus reads as the threat to the sustaining arrangement dominating the event — the scare is the story — while the older national charts (1801 Union chart in particular) are not read as receiving a severing blow sufficient to end the European tie at this pass. No full chart data (houses, exact degrees beyond the one conjunction given) is supplied, so no further chart factors are fabricated; confidence is held down accordingly, and the 'question returns' rider is a scope note, not a second direction.
